import re

STEP = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<step>Compiling|Finished|Running|Doc-tests|Fresh|Updating|Downloaded|Downloading|Checking|Blocking)\s+(?P<detail>.*\S)\s*$')
TEST = re.compile(r'^test (?P<name>.+?) \.\.\. ?(?P<status>ok|FAILED|ignored(?:, .*)?)?\s*$')
STAT = re.compile(r'^(ok|FAILED|ignored)\s*$')
PANIC = re.compile(r"^thread '(?P<thread>[^']*)'(?: \((?P<tid>\d+)\))? panicked at (?P<loc>.+?):?\s*$")
FRAME = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<idx>\d+): (?P<func>.+?)\s*$')
AT = re.compile(r'^\s+at (?P<loc>.+?)\s*$')
RESULT = re.compile(r'^test result: (?P<result>\w+)\. (?P<rest>.*)$')
RUNNING = re.compile(r'^running (?P<n>\d+) tests?\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    steps = {'name': 'cargo_steps', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    tests = {'name': 'tests', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    panics = {'name': 'panics', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    frames = {'name': 'backtrace', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    fails = {'name': 'failures', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    summary = {'name': 'summary', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    errors = {'name': 'errors', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': [], 'records': []}
    skip = []
    pending = None
    panic = None
    thread = ''
    in_fail = False
    in_msg = False
    n = len(lines)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        s = lines[i]
        t = s.strip()
        if not t:
            i += 1
            continue
        m = STEP.match(s)
        if m:
            steps['records'].append({'step': m.group('step'), 'detail': m.group('detail')})
            steps['lines'].append(i)
            in_msg = False
            i += 1
            continue
        m = RUNNING.match(s)
        if m:
            summary['records'].append({'running': int(m.group('n'))})
            summary['lines'].append(i)
            in_fail = False
            in_msg = False
            i += 1
            continue
        m = RESULT.match(s)
        if m:
            rec = {'result': m.group('result')}
            for part in m.group('rest').split(';'):
                part = part.strip()
                pm = re.match(r'^(\d+) (.+)$', part)
                if pm:
                    rec[pm.group(2)] = int(pm.group(1))
                else:
                    pm = re.match(r'^finished in (.+)$', part)
                    if pm:
                        rec['finished in'] = pm.group(1)
            summary['records'].append(rec)
            summary['lines'].append(i)
            in_fail = False
            in_msg = False
            i += 1
            continue
        m = TEST.match(s)
        if m:
            rec = {'test': m.group('name'), 'status': m.group('status') or ''}
            tests['records'].append(rec)
            tests['lines'].append(i)
            pending = rec if not m.group('status') else None
            in_msg = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if pending is not None and STAT.match(s):
            pending['status'] = t
            tests['lines'].append(i)
            pending = None
            in_msg = False
            i += 1
            continue
        m = PANIC.match(s)
        if m:
            thread = m.group('thread')
            panic = {'thread': thread, 'tid': m.group('tid') or '', 'location': m.group('loc'), 'message': ''}
            panics['records'].append(panic)
            panics['lines'].append(i)
            in_msg = True
            i += 1
            continue
        if t == 'stack backtrace:' or t.startswith('note:') or re.match(r'^---- .* ----$', t):
            skip.append(i)
            in_msg = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if t == 'failures:':
            skip.append(i)
            in_fail = True
            in_msg = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if t.startswith('error:') or t.startswith('error['):
            errors['records'].append({'error': t.split(':', 1)[1].strip() if ':' in t else t})
            errors['lines'].append(i)
            in_msg = False
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_msg and panic is not None:
            panic['message'] = (panic['message'] + '\n' + t) if panic['message'] else t
            panics['lines'].append(i)
            i += 1
            continue
        m = FRAME.match(s)
        if m and not in_fail:
            rec = {'thread': thread, 'frame': int(m.group('idx')), 'function': m.group('func'), 'location': ''}
            frames['lines'].append(i)
            if i + 1 < n:
                am = AT.match(lines[i + 1])
                if am:
                    rec['location'] = am.group('loc')
                    frames['lines'].append(i + 1)
                    i += 1
            frames['records'].append(rec)
            i += 1
            continue
        if in_fail and re.match(r'^\s+\S+\s*$', s):
            fails['records'].append({'test': t})
            fails['lines'].append(i)
            i += 1
            continue
        i += 1
    blocks = [b for b in (steps, tests, panics, frames, fails, summary, errors) if b['records']]
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
